_comment: Canonical fixtures for 001 — Timeline performance. Shapes match the FeedItem contract in 03-contract.md. Used by 05-ui-mockup.html and by the plan's Pest tests (one definition — the mockup must not hand-roll different sample data).

viewer._note: coordinates exist server-side only; never in a fixture consumed by the UI layer

feed_page_1._comment: first lazy-loaded page: mixed posts/events, newest first (001-O1), merged list

items.title: Pickup volleyball at the beach, come thru

items._comment: soft conversion threshold (>=5 reactions per decisions.md) — badge shows, owner-only
items.title: Impromptu trivia night, who's in?

items._comment: already converted — card shows the converted overlay, not the reaction button
items.title: Weekly 5k run club
items.description: Became a recurring event — join the structured version.

adversarial._comment: cross-cutting hostile/edge cases the plan and mockup must both handle

expired_post_excluded._note: must never appear in feed_page_1 — FeedService excludes it server-side, not a client filter

out_of_radius_post._note: beyond the fixed 10km post radius (001-O2) — must never appear regardless of event radius slider

out_of_radius_event._note: beyond the 50km event radius ceiling — excluded even with eventRadiusKm=50

no_image_event._note: mockup must render a placeholder, not a broken

unauthenticated_viewer._note: guest hitting /feed/nearby redirects to login (route middleware, unchanged — see 03-contract.md Authorization)

malformed_cursor._note: FeedService must treat as null and restart from newest, never 500 (see 03-contract.md Validation)

viewer_without_location._note: falls back to FeedService::getFallbackNearbyFeed per existing behavior, unchanged by this spec
